About the Data Scientist position

We are looking for a skilled Data Scientist who will help us analyze large amounts of raw information to find patterns and use them to optimize our performance. You will build data products to extract valuable business insights, analyze trends and help us make better decisions.

We expect you to be highly analytical with a knack for analysis, math and statistics, and a passion for machine-learning and research. Critical thinking and problem-solving skills are also required.

Data Scientist responsibilities are:

•
Research and detect valuable data sources and automate collection processes

•
Perform preprocessing of structured and unstructured data

• Design, implement and deliver maintainable and high-quality code using best practices (e.g. Git/Github, Secrets, Configurations, Yaml/JSON)

•
Review large amounts of information to discover trends and patterns

•
Create predictive models and machine-learning algorithms

•
Modify and combine different models through ensemble modeling

•
Organize and present information using data visualization techniques

•
Develop and suggest solutions and strategies to business challenges

•
Work together with engineering and product development teams

Data Scientist requirements are:

• 3+ years' experience of working on Data Scientist or Data Analyst position

•
Significant experience in data mining, machine-learning and operations research

• Experience with data modeling, design patterns, building highly scalable and secured solutions preferred

• Prior experience installing data architectures on Cloud providers (e.g. AWS,GCP,Azure), using DevOps tools and automating data pipelines

•
Good experience using business intelligence/visualization tools (such as Tableau), data frameworks (such as Hadoop, DataFrames, RDDs, Dataclasses) and data formats (CSV, JSON, Parquet, Avro, ORC)

•
Advanced knowledge of R, SQL and Python; familiarity with Scala, Java or C++ is an asset

• MA or PhD degree in Computer Science, Engineering or other relevant area; graduate degree in Data Science or other quantitative field is preferred

• Must be a U.S. Citizen

Why UKG:
At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.
We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
About the team
Our Go-to-Market Data Science team turns UKG workforce data into insights that help customers and business leaders understand their workforce. We develop benchmarks, conduct applied research, and partner with economists, Communications, Product, and Engineering to connect what happens in the flow of work with broader labor market trends.
About the role
We are seeking a Principal Larbor Market Data Scientist to lead hands-on research and analysis focused on labor and workforce insights. As a senior individual contributor, you will own work from defining the question and investigating the data through validating findings and explaining their significance to business leaders.
This role is dedicated to supporting UKG senior leaders, Corporate Communications, and our labor economists with evidence for executive-to-executive discussions, media interviews, press releases, and thought leadership. Working closely with our economist colleagues, you will combine UKG workforce data with external labor market sources to develop timely insights that inform executive discussions and external communications. You will bring the technical depth to build the analysis and the judgment to determine what the evidence supports.
Responsibilities
+ Partner with labor economists and Communications to define research questions and produce validated analyses, charts, and supporting materials for executive briefings, customer discussions, and media preparation.
+ Lead original research on hiring, separations, hours worked, wages, labor supply, and other workforce trends. Identify questions that matter to employers and workers, and investigate changes across industries, geographies, and workforce segments.
+ Deliver executive briefings, charts, talking points, and supporting analysis for customer discussions and media engagements.
+ Excellent written and verbal communication, with experience translating quantitative findings into concise, accurate materials for leaders, business audiences, or public use.
+ Own the analytical response to urgent executive and media questions. Clarify the question, assess feasibility, and deliver findings with the context and limitations needed to use them accurately.
+ Combine large-scale UKG workforce data with public and commercial labor data. Evaluate source definitions, coverage, reporting lags, and comparability before drawing conclusions.
+ Develop and validate statistical methods for workforce indicators, trends, and comparisons. Address seasonality, changing employer populations, missing data, revisions, and sampling bias; distinguish workforce changes from data artifacts and association from causation.
+ Build reproducible analysis and recurring reporting workflows using SQL and Python. Maintain documented methods, versioned code, and automated checks so results can be reproduced, reviewed, and updated efficiently.
+ Review the numerical accuracy and interpretation of findings, charts, and proposed public claims. Explain uncertainty, challenge unsupported conclusions, and recommend when findings need further analysis before use.
+ Partner with Product, Engineering, and data owners to resolve source issues and improve the datasets supporting workforce insights. Apply appropriate privacy protections and aggregation standards in collaboration with Legal and privacy teams.
+ Provide technical leadership and mentor data scientists through research design, code review, and stakeholder discussions. Lead substantial workstreams independently and communicate priorities, tradeoffs, and delivery risks clearly.
Basic qualifications
+ Bachelor’s degree or higher in statistics, data science, economics, computer science, mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
+ 8+ years of relevant experience in data science, applied statistics, quantitative research, or a related field, with demonstrated ownership of complex analytical work and influence at a senior level.
+ Substantial hands-on experience analyzing labor market or workforce data in recent professional roles, including producing research, indicators, or insights from employment, payroll, wage, hours, job posting, or worker-level datasets.
+ Deep applied statistical expertise, including time-series analysis, sampling and weighting, hypothesis testing, and uncertainty estimation. Ability to select methods appropriate to the data and question.
+ Strong SQL and Python skills, including the ability to work independently with large, complex datasets and build maintainable, reproducible analytical workflows.
+ Demonstrated ability to assess data quality and representativeness, reconcile inconsistent sources, and explain how methodological choices affect conclusions.
+ Ability to explain analytical findings, methods, and limitations clearly to technical and nontechnical colleagues and collaborate on materials for business audiences.
+ Ability to lead ambiguous research assignments independently, collaborate with economists and technical partners, and deliver sound analysis under time-sensitive conditions.
Preferred qualifications
+ Master’s or PhD in a relevant quantitative discipline.
+ Recent experience developing labor market research, indicators, or data products at a statistical agency, payroll provider, workforce analytics organization, or comparable research institution.
+ Experience supporting corporate communications, economic publications, executive briefings, or media preparation, including reviewing research for public release.
+ Experience with econometrics, forecasting, or causal inference applied to labor and workforce questions.
+ Experience with Google Cloud Platform and BigQuery, workforce management or human capital management data, and recurring labor market indicators or benchmark publications.

UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform with unified HR, payroll, and workforce management, built to solve the unique challenges of frontline work. Powered by people-first AI and decades of labor data, UKG turns workforce intelligence into real-time decisions around staffing, pay, compliance, and productivity, enabling every worker to confidently take action as work happens. That’s why more than 80,000 organizations worldwide trust UKG to run their workforce — not just manage it. Learn more at ukg.com.

**A career that’s the whole package!**

At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.

**Conga** lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.

**AI Data Scientist**

**Location**: Houston - Hybrid, Canada - Remote

**Reports to:** Senior Director, Science | Platform AI - R&D

## A quick snapshot…

As an AI Data Scientist at Conga, you will be a hands-on technical leader responsible for researching, building, evaluating, and deploying the natural language and machine learning capabilities that power our revenue lifecycle management solutions. You will work across traditional NLP, statistical machine learning, deep learning, and Generative AI to solve complex product and business problems, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, and Data Science teams to take solutions from first experiment to production at scale.

This role is ideal for a scientist who pairs deep research instincts with a builder's mindset. You understand both the theory and the practical tradeoffs behind NLP and ML, and you know how to choose the right approach based on data, performance, latency, cost, and business need.

## Why it's a big deal…

At Conga, AI is central to how we help customers make sense of their most complex commercial documents and decisions. Contracts, quotes, and agreements are rich with unstructured language, and turning that language into trusted insight is one of the biggest opportunities in front of us.

As an AI Data Scientist, you will help shape how Conga applies NLP and Generative AI across our platform. Your work will directly influence product intelligence, model quality, and the experience thousands of customers rely on every day. You'll also help raise the technical bar across the team through mentorship, rigorous evaluation standards, and a steady stream of applied research.

You'll work alongside a highly talented team of scientists and engineers dedicated to solving hard problems while supporting products that help customers streamline and transform their revenue operations.

## What you'll lead…

**Applied Research & Innovation**

* Research and evaluate emerging NLP, machine learning, deep learning, and Generative AI techniques, translating the most promising advances into practical solutions.
* Investigate ambiguous technical problems independently, form hypotheses, and run experiments that compare competing approaches.
* Continuously evaluate new models, frameworks, and methodologies, adopting those with demonstrated potential to improve product capabilities and system performance.

**NLP & Machine Learning Development**

* Design and build traditional NLP, statistical ML, deep learning, and transformer-based solutions using the right algorithms, architectures, and representations for the problem.
* Develop data pipelines, NLP preprocessing, feature representations, embeddings, and training datasets across structured and unstructured data.
* Establish data-quality strategies that keep models reliable as data and use cases evolve.

**Generative AI & LLM Solutions**

* Develop and evaluate LLM and GenAI solutions using prompting, RAG, embeddings, vector search, fine-tuning, agents, and structured generation.
* Select and optimize models based on accuracy, latency, cost, and business requirements.
* Help define how Conga builds, grounds, and governs GenAI capabilities across the platform.

**Evaluation & Experimentation Excellence**

* Design rigorous experiments, benchmarks, evaluation datasets, and statistical methodologies to measure and improve NLP, ML, and GenAI systems.
* Lead error analysis and performance measurement that turn results into clear next steps.
* Set evaluation standards the broader team can adopt and build on.

**Production & Operational Excellence**

* Take NLP and AI solutions from research and prototype through production deployment, monitoring, and ongoing optimization.
* Partner with engineering teams to operationalize models at scale with strong reliability and performance.
* Proactively identify model drift, quality gaps, and optimization opportunities in live systems.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Mentorship**

* Collaborate with engineering, product, and data science teams to solve complex problems and shape technical direction.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship in NLP, ML, experimentation, and GenAI.
* Foster a culture of curiosity, scientific rigor, and continuous learning.

## Are you the person we're looking for?

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computational Linguistics, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Ph.D. preferred but not required.
* 10+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, NLP, or AI, including significant hands-on experience building and deploying NLP and/or GenAI solutions.
* Proven experience taking ML, NLP, or GenAI solutions from experimentation through production deployment and ongoing optimization.
* Demonstrated ability to translate open-ended research into practical, measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication skills and a track record of working effectively as a senior individual contributor across technical teams.

## Technical Expertise

* Expert-level Python with extensive use of Hugging Face Transformers, spaCy, NLTK, Sentence Transformers, PyTorch, and TensorFlow.
* Expert knowledge of traditional NLP, including tokenization, stemming, lemmatization, n-grams, TF-IDF, topic modeling, text classification, named entity recognition, information extraction, semantic similarity, and information retrieval.
* Strong understanding of deep learning architectures, including CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, GRUs, encoder-decoder models, attention mechanisms, and Transformers.
* Strong understanding of Transformer-based language models, including embeddings, pretraining, fine-tuning, and inference.
* Hands-on experience with LLMs and foundation models, including prompt engineering, RAG, vector search, reranking, fine-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, structured generation, and LLM evaluation.
* Strong grasp of experimental design, statistical testing, cross-validation, hyperparameter optimization, and error analysis.
* Experience with NLP and GenAI evaluation metrics, including precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, MAP, MRR, NDCG, semantic similarity, groundedness, and relevance.
* Strong SQL skills and experience with structured and unstructured data at scale.
* Experience with distributed data processing platforms such as Spark, Databricks, or BigQuery.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Databricks, GCP, AWS, or Azure and modern ML infrastructure.
* Experience with ML tooling such as MLflow, Kubeflow, Weights & Biases, Docker, Kubernetes, or Ray.
* Experience with vector databases and search technologies such as FAISS, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus.
* Familiarity with LLM application frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or DSPy.

## Key Competencies

**Research Depth**

You bring strong theoretical foundations and the curiosity to explore new techniques, while staying grounded in what will actually move the product forward.

**Builder's Mindset**

You enjoy getting hands-on, turning prototypes into production systems, and owning outcomes well past the first experiment.

**Scientific Rigor**

You hold yourself and your team to high standards for evaluation, measurement, and evidence-based decisions.

**Collaboration & Communication**

You partner effectively across functions and explain complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences.

**Technical Leadership**

You elevate those around you through mentorship, thoughtful guidance, and sound technical judgment.

## Here's what will give you an edge…

* Experience with NLP in the legal domain, such as NER, document classification, or semantic search over legal documents.
* Experience with advanced information retrieval, semantic search, document intelligence, multimodal models, or knowledge graphs.
* Experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning, model quantization, distillation, inference optimization, synthetic data generation, and agentic architectures.
* Advanced knowledge of cloud AI/ML platforms and distributed training and inference for large-scale LLM systems.
* Contributions to the field through publications, patents, open-source projects, conference talks, or technical writing.
* Experience working within Agile, cross-functional product development teams.

## Travel

Limited travel to other Conga offices upon request.

**Did we pique your interest?** 

If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. We'd love to hear from you! 

**Preferred Resume Format**

We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly.

**Don’t meet every requirement for the role?**  

Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If reasonable accommodation is needed to allow you to show us your best self, please let your recruiter know as soon as possible. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Conga is not open to third party solicitation or resumes for our posted FTE positions. Resumes received from third party agencies that are unsolicited will be considered complimentary.

**Conga's Applicant Privacy Statement**

The information you provide during the application process will be used in accordance with Conga’s Applicant Privacy Statement ([https://conga.com/applicant-privacy-statement](https://conga.com/applicant-privacy-statement)). By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the terms outlined in this privacy statement.

A Career that Empowers You to Build Your Future As a Senior Data Scientist on Lennar's People Analytics team, you'll build the models that anticipate what's ahead for our workforce: attrition and turnover risk, hiring and headcount needs, and the trends underneath them. You'll also build the AI agents that deliver that work directly to HR leaders, so forecasts reach the point of decision rather than sitting in a report. This is a newly created position and the first dedicated data science role on the People Analytics team. You'll have significant latitude in shaping how the work gets done, from the modeling approaches we adopt to the standards we hold for validation and how results are presented to senior leadership. You'll work closely with HR COEs and hands-on with Workday and other people systems, plus the metrics Visier surfaces on top of them. You'll report to the Head of People Analytics. Your Responsibilities on the Team Partner directly with HR leaders to understand what they need forecasted or automated and build models and agents they trust enough to act on. Build and deploy predictive models in Python and SQL. Monitor model performance over time, retesting as new data arrives and refining when accuracy drifts, so predictions and recommendations stay reliable. Build AI agents that can query People data, reason over it, and take action, along with the tool use, orchestration, and guardrails that let them work safely with sensitive workforce data. Select the method that fits the question, apply experimentation and causal inference where the question is about cause, quantify uncertainty, and be prepared to explain the approach to senior leadership. Use LLMs to surface patterns in unstructured People data such as survey comments and exit interview notes and incorporate what you find into your models. Develop deep familiarity with Lennar's people data, extracting and structuring what your models require, identifying gaps that would sharpen the output, and partnering with Data Engineering on the pipelines behind it. Explain statistical concepts, model results, and agent behavior to HR and business audiences without a quantitative background. Handle sensitive workforce and compensation data with discretion. Requirements Bachelor’s degree or higher in Statistics, Economics, Math, Computer Science, or a related analytical field with equivalent experience. 5+ years of relevant experience (1+ with PhD, 3+ with MS) as a data scientist producing models and engineering solutions in a production environment. Depth in predictive modeling, including regression, time series forecasting, and classification. A strong statistical foundation, including experimentation and causal inference, and the judgment to select the right method for the question at hand. Proven ability to work independently, including designing your own validation approach and articulating your methodology to technical and non-technical reviewers. Hands-on experience building with LLMs, whether agents, tool use and function calling, retrieval, or prompt-driven workflows, and using tools such as Claude to accelerate your own development. We're interested in what you've built and how you evaluated it, more than years of experience in a field this new. Experience with large, complex operational or HR datasets, including cleaning and structuring messy data and extracting it yourself through SQL or APIs. Fluency in SQL and strong proficiency in Python. Ability to explain model results and agent behavior in plain language to non-technical HR and business leaders.
